name: Bar Las Vegas
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Bar Las Vegas in Tirol!**

Step into a world of glamour and excitement at **Bar Las Vegas**, where the vibrant energy of the famous **Las Vegas** meets the breathtaking beauty of the **Tirol** Alps. Whether you're looking for a lively evening with friends, a romantic date, or a fun night out, our bar offers the perfect mix of entertainment and relaxation.

Indulge in our carefully crafted cocktails, served with a smile by our friendly bartenders. From classic **Tirol** specialties to international favorites, our menu has something for every taste. Try our signature **Kaiserschmarrn** cocktail—fluffy, sweet, and utterly delicious—or enjoy a refreshing **Apfelstrudel** martini for a taste of **Tirol**’s culinary delights.

Dance the night away to the latest hits or enjoy live music on select evenings. Our cozy yet stylish atmosphere ensures you’ll feel right at home, whether you’re sipping a cocktail by the bar or dancing on the floor.

Located in the heart of **Tirol**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Bar Las Vegas** is the ideal spot for a memorable night out. Come experience the best of both worlds—**Tirol**’s charm and **Las Vegas**’ excitement—all in one place!

**Reservations recommended.** We look forward to welcoming you!
